commentary_segments.text: Up till now only random effects have been examined. They lead to a random offset and random CMRR, which are linked by each other. Systematic errors can also occur. In general, they are the result of systematic asymmetries. In principle, they can be avoided by proper design, as they are systematic. They give rise to a systematic offset and systematic CMRR which are also linked. Some examples are given next.
